findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "start_sign_up" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Start an optional Hocus Games account for a person who asked for it, with ONLY their email address and, optionally, the genres, graphics styles, themes and tone…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_game_details, start_sign_up, check_game_url, get_submission_status · Private data: get_game_details, start_sign_up, submit_game · Public sink: start_sign_up, submit_game, get_submission_status · Destructive: check_game_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_game_details, start_sign_up, check_game_url, get_submission_status · Private data: get_game_details, start_sign_up, submit_game · Public sink: start_sign_up, submit_game, get_submission_status · Destructive: check_game_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
